answer: An agent economy resists Sybil by requiring each identity to continuously advance an exclusive sequential memory-hard spiral whose current working set is a non-double-committed timber held live in process memory. The timber cannot be pooled or shared across clones. Any correlated fault observed by the garden of independent peer witnesses jointly slashes the full exclusive collateral locked to that spiral, so a farm of n clones must fund n separate timbers and collaterals with no amortization.
